verdict.rationale: Docs give rough ballpark latency figures (~0.5s for instant/direct vector search, <2min for agentic search) but these are marketing approximations, not documented p50/p95 targets or measured benchmark numbers with methodology. Missing for 10: percentile-based latency benchmarks (p50/p95), load/throughput testing data, methodology or environment details behind the '~0.5sec' figure, and independent hands-on latency measurements corroborating the claim.
